nativeCanvasException.actual: Every immutable generator original is a 1254x1254 opaque RGB PNG on a uniform chroma-green extraction matte.
nativeCanvasException.canonicalPolicy: After explicit Human source approval, canonical straight-alpha masters and documented small-scale optical derivatives use the established achievement delivery canvases and encodings.
nativeCanvasException.exception: Immutable generator originals remain native and are never rescaled or converted in place. Chroma extraction, edge cleanup, registration, resize, optical tuning, encoding, runtime publication, and catalogue changes occur only after source review.

lineagePolicy.identityReference: Each current runtime achievement is semantic identity evidence only; approved Bunny, Fox, and Kitten sources additionally govern their named friend identities.
lineagePolicy.renderingAuthority: Only the approved mgjrpg-02 recipe and Human-approved nav-home and moon-wand sources govern sticker construction, enamel, foil, jewel, contour, and value craft.
lineagePolicy.pendingBatch20FirstStarSource: not used as a reference or rendering authority

reviewProtocol.decisionRule: Human reviews all fifteen selected proof candidates for semantic fidelity, coherent premium material hierarchy, cream cutline quality, matte separability, and legibility at 91, 64, 52, 40, and 32 pixels before any source is approved; the two internal-QA rejects remain recorded as immutable provenance but are not proof selections.
reviewProtocol.candidateBoundary: Source approval does not extract alpha, create optical derivatives, switch runtime files, change catalogue pointers, or retire previous art.

rights.originClaim: Generated for Maze so Puzzle from exact prompts and internal approved or semantic-only references; no named franchise, character, logo, living artist, proprietary palette, UI layout, or composition was requested.

rollback.method: Keep every immutable output and exact prompt. All current Adventure Book runtime files, source records, catalogue pointers, preload behavior, and platform packaging remain unchanged until explicit Human selection and a later publication gate.
